Get the daily price history of coins

Source: R/fct_data.R
get_history.Rd

Returns the daily USD prices of one or more coins from 'CoinMarketCap'. Each coin's history is kept on disk between R sessions, and once it is more than an hour old only the days since its last day are downloaded, so calls are fast and stay below the request limit of 'CoinMarketCap'. When that limit is hit, crypto2 waits a minute and tries again.

Usage

get_history(labels, start_date = Sys.Date() - 365, coins = get_coins())

Arguments

labels

Character vector of coin labels, such as "Bitcoin (BTC)", from the name_symbol column of get_coins().

start_date

Date. The first day to get, a year ago by default.

coins

Data frame of coins from get_coins(), to look the labels up.

Value

A data frame with one row per coin and day, sorted by coin and date, with the open, high, low, close and volume columns, timestamp as a Date and the name_symbol label. Labels that match no coin are left out with a message, and NULL is returned when no label matches or nothing could be downloaded.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
btc <- get_history("Bitcoin (BTC)", as.Date("2020-01-01"))
plot_timeseries(btc)

history <- get_history(c("Bitcoin (BTC)", "Ethereum (ETH)"))
plot_compare(normalize_prices(history))
} # }
